note: The YOLOv8x-seg localiser and the 3-class standalone model were trained on the original Roboflow split, NOT the source-grouped leak-free split used for the classifiers. This is how much of the 205-image internal classification test set those segmentation models had already seen.
consequence: Internal numbers for the standalone YOLO and for the two-stage pipeline (whose localiser front-end leaks) are optimistic. Segmentation mAP is clean (YOLO's own test split has zero source overlap with its train split) and all external numbers are clean (zero overlap). The oracle-mask and Benchmark 1 results use ground-truth masks and are unaffected.
